Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
We generated $17.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $14.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $14.0 billion this quarter, representing 10% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $14.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 359 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 10% to 14% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
